title: Set the org's default display density
when: The step sets the org-wide default display density for Lightning Experience, Comfy or Compact, on the Density Settings page. It is not one user's own density preference, which they set from their profile menu.
steps: On the Density Settings page, choose the density the step asks for: Comfy or Compact.
If a Save button is offered, click it. Otherwise the choice saves by itself.
doneWhen: Density Settings shows the requested density as the selected org default.

verified.outcome: Trial steps matched at p=1.00. Compact: 1 action, reviewer confirmed. Comfy: 1 action, 21 s, reviewer confirmed, and a fresh session showed Comfy selected. A pure Lightning page that saves on selection. Salesforce leaves no Setup Audit Trail entry for it. The first fresh-session check failed only because it looked before the page had drawn; a page just opened now gets a more patient look.

trial.step: Set the org default display density to Comfy.

notes: Browserforce covers this as density-settings. A pure Lightning page, not an embedded Classic one.
